app.name: Live Game Translator
app.subtitle: Stay with the story
app.privacy: Only translation text and related context are sent to the selected provider.

shell.subtitle: Current subtitle
shell.subtitleEmpty: Subtitles appear when a new line arrives.
shell.glossaryEmpty: No glossary terms in this profile yet.

capture.title: Capture source
capture.hint: Drag over the image to select text. Keep the selection close to the subtitles.
capture.previewError: Video preview is unavailable. Refresh or select the window again; if watching, stop and start again.
capture.changed: Check the text region after resizing or changing the source layout.
capture.noSources: No windows found. Open the source application and refresh.

translation.title: Translate window
translation.subtitle: From the screen you play to the story you understand.
translation.ocrEmpty: Text from the selected region will appear here.
translation.historyHint: Start watching, then translate now or enable automatic translation.
translation.speaker: Speaker
translation.skipped: Skipped because the queue was full
translation.cached: Local cache · no new API request
translation.overlayHint: Drag to move. Lock again to click through the subtitles.
translation.summaryEmpty: A summary is created after enough dialogue.
translation.needsSetup: OCR works right away. To translate, select a provider and model in Settings; OpenRouter requires an API key.

context.title: Game profiles
context.subtitle: Consistent names. Relationships that sound right.
context.name: Profile name
context.instructionsHint: For example: preserve proper names, use a historical tone, the protagonist uses tôi.
context.direction: Each row is one direction. Add a separate rule for the reverse direction.
context.empty: No entries yet. Add characters or terms as you encounter them.
context.savedHint: Saving rules for the active profile pauses the session to prevent outdated context.
context.confirmClear: Clear characters, forms of address, terms, and AI suggestions for “{{name}}”? The name, priority translation rules, and dialogue history will be kept. AI will learn from new dialogue only; the active session will pause.
context.aiEnabled: Automatically enrich this profile with AI
context.aiToggleHint: Applies after saving. AI fills missing information; changes to existing values require your approval.
context.aiHint: AI uses the game name when initializing and translated dialogue for later updates. Check important information.

aiStatus.waiting: Waiting for configuration or more dialogue
aiStatus.cleared: Profile data cleared. AI can learn from new dialogue or initialize again when you retry.
aiStatus.no_data: AI found no game data during initialization. It can still learn from dialogue.

context.changedElsewhere: This profile has been updated. Your draft is preserved; reload to see the latest data before saving.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your translation preferences and reading space.
settings.keyHint: Leave empty to keep the current key. Keys are encrypted and never displayed again.
settings.searchModels: Search by model name or ID…
settings.noModels: No models available. Check the server and reload the list.
settings.modelPriceHint: Free models first, then by the sum of input and output prices.
settings.chooseModel: Choose a model with structured JSON output
settings.duplicateHint: Default 80%. 0% disables filtering; 100% skips only identical normalized text. Applies to automatic translation; Translate now can translate again. Lower thresholds may skip different meanings or unfinished lines. Original casing is preserved for AI.
settings.overlayDurationHint: Hide 1-60 seconds after the caption changes. New captions appear again.
settings.preview: Ta sẽ không bỏ con lại phía sau.
settings.saveHint: Settings save automatically. Changing provider, address, translation model, or key/token pauses the session; changing background models does not.
settings.profileLearningHint: 1–200 successfully translated dialogues, default 20. Runs in the background alongside translation.
settings.profileInputTokenLimitHint: Default 15,000; range 1,000–1,000,000. Covers summaries, profile creation and enrichment, including prompts and schemas. The model context limit still applies; dialogue translation keeps its 6,000 cap.
settings.lmStudioHint: Start the LM Studio server, then enter its API address ending in /v1.
settings.optionalTokenHint: A token is only required when server authentication is enabled.
settings.localModelHint: Load models from the server, then select a text model.
settings.ollamaHint: Start the Ollama server, then enter its API address ending in /v1.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Invalid input. Check the fields and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This window cannot perform that action.
errors.INTERNAL: Could not complete the action. Please try again.
errors.API_KEY: The API key/token is missing or the server rejected the credentials.
errors.MODEL: Choose a model with structured outputs in Settings.
errors.NETWORK: Cannot connect to the model server. Check the address, network, and server status.
errors.TIMEOUT: The request timed out. You can retry this dialogue.
errors.RATE_LIMIT: The provider is limiting requests. Try again later.
errors.RESPONSE: The model response did not match the required structure.
errors.CONTEXT_LIMIT: Rules and new dialogue exceed the context budget. Shorten the rules or select another model.
errors.CAPTURE: No new frames available. Check and reselect the source window.
errors.OCR: Text recognition failed. Check the region or restart capture.
errors.SHORTCUT: A shortcut is invalid, duplicated or already used by another application.
errors.STORAGE: Could not read/write data or securely encrypt the API key.
errors.PROFILE_CHANGED: The profile has changed. Reload the latest data before saving or approving a suggestion.

debug.title: Request log
debug.description: Data stays in memory during debug and is cleared when the app closes. API keys are hidden.
